artworks.title: Old Point Comfort and the Hygeia Hotel
artworks.description: The image features two views in sepia tones. The top image shows a seaside scene with sailing boats, structures on the shoreline, ships in the distance, and figures near the shore. The second image shows the Hygeia Hotel from the side, with colonial architecture, people walking along a path, and foliage surrounding the building. Both images have fine, detailed brushstrokes.

artworks.title: The Salt Pond from the Salt Pond Knob, No. 2
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with hills, ridges, clouds, and a group of people at the foreground.

artworks.title: Red Sulphur Spring
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape viewed from an elevated angle, displaying a valley between hills. The horizon is ambiguous, with hills extending into the distance. Various structures, including a circular building with columns, are visible to the left, along with others scattered across the scene. A path winds through trees connecting the buildings. The image appears to be a lithograph with precise lines and subtle gradients. The color palette is subdued, mainly using greens, browns, and muted blues. Shading is used to depict depth, especially in trees and hills. The artwork conveys a peaceful rural scene.

artworks.title: Viaduct on Cheat River, Baltimore & Ohio Railroad
artworks.description: The image shows a viaduct over the Cheat River as part of the B&O Railroad. The perspective is aerial, revealing the landscape below with hills, clouds, and the river. A bridge with trusses crosses the river, and hills covered in trees are visible in the background. Two men in 19th-century clothing stand on a rocky outcrop, one gesturing towards the viaduct. The scene is depicted in sepia tones, with detailed brushstrokes showing natural and man-made elements. The color scheme is earthy and warm, enhancing the historical and timeless feel of the image.

artworks.title: Falling Springs
artworks.description: The image shows a waterfall flowing down a rocky cliff from a slightly elevated angle. The horizon is not distinctly defined. The top of the waterfall cascades from a cliff lined with trees. The brushstrokes are precise and detailed, typical of an illustrative print. Clear lines define the texture of the rocks and the movement of the water. The color palette features earthy tones of browns and greens, contrasting with the white and light gray of the waterfalls. Closest to us are large rocks and a stream of water. Figures are visible to the right. In the background, a row of trees creates a border.

artworks.title: Salt Sulphur Spring
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape of a small community surrounded by hills. The perspective is elevated, showing a wide view over the scene. The horizon is high with hills extending into the distance with trees. The artwork has a smooth texture and a monochromatic sepia color palette. In the foreground, there is a field with a curved log fence, and buildings are scattered beyond with trees and slopes.

artworks.title: Kanawha Fall
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a river flowing over rocks. Hills with trees occupy the middle ground, and a structure similar to a gazebo or pavilion is near the riverbank. The river flows through the lower part of the image, interrupted by rocky outcrops. In the distance, open fields with trees and small houses are visible. The color palette includes muted tones of beige, gray, and subtle greens, creating a serene atmosphere. The brushstrokes are delicate and precise, detailing the landscape.

artworks.title: Hot Springs
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape view of a rustic town with scattered buildings nestled among trees. In the distance, a line of gentle, wooded hills forms the horizon, with a large hill or mountain mass positioned left of center. The background is dominated by this hill, with a textured appearance created by subtle brushstrokes. The color palette is muted, primarily in sepia tones and soft greens. Light and shadow play across the terrain, highlighting the land's contours and structures.

artworks.title: View from Gambles Hill
artworks.description: The image shows a panoramic view from Gambles Hill. In the foreground, a couple with a child walks on a pathway. Two horse-drawn carriages are also present. The horizon in the upper third shows rolling hills, buildings, and trees. A river flows through the scene, reflecting the sky. Detailed architecture includes various buildings and a structure with a central dome. Muted earthy tones create a serene atmosphere. The lithograph technique accentuates fine details in the buildings and landscape.

artworks.title: Bullard Rock on the New River
artworks.description: The image depicts a river reflecting rock formations in the background. The horizon is high in the image, emphasizing the rocks' verticality. The brushstrokes are fine and detailed, resembling lithographic prints, providing a textured quality. Earth tones and shades of grey, brown, and orange dominate the color palette. In the foreground, there is a rowboat with two figures and another figure on the riverbank. The scene transitions into a wooded area with trees between the rocks.

artworks.title: Rockbridge Alum Spring
artworks.description: The image depicts Rockbridge Alum Spring in Rockbridge County, Virginia. The viewpoint is elevated, showcasing a wide view of the area. A rolling green hill forms the background, with white buildings and trees in the center. The illustration shows detailed trees, buildings, and the landscape with precise brushstrokes. The color scheme includes earthy greens and browns, with hints of soft blues in the sky. In the foreground, a grassy slope leads towards the village-like scene.

artworks.title: The Little Tunnel Near Shawsville, Virginia and Tennessee Railroad
artworks.description: The image displays an elevated view of a rural landscape. A train emerges from a tunnel on the left side. The horizon, mountains, clear sky, clouds, grassy terrain with rocks and trees, rolling hills, and a river winding through the scene are depicted in detailed and precise painting style using earthy tones of green and brown, with soft hues of blue and gray.

artworks.title: Old Sweet Spa
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape scene with a valley stretching toward rolling hills. The hills form the horizon line with a settlement below, nestled amongst trees. The style is detailed with a muted color palette of earth tones. The composition leads the eye towards the hills, creating a sense of balance and tranquility.

artworks.title: Blue Sulphur Spring
artworks.description: The image shows a view titled "Blue Sulphur Spring" from Greenbrier County, Virginia. The landscape features rolling hills, trees, buildings, and a horse-drawn carriage on a dirt road. In the center, there is a grove of trees with structures. The style appears to be a lithograph with smooth lines and blended colors in earthy tones.

artworks.title: The Salt Pond from the Salt Pond Knob, No. 1
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with rolling hills, a pond, and figures. The viewpoint is elevated, offering a wide view of the scene. The horizon line is near the upper third of the image, dividing the hills from the sky. The brushwork is detailed and delicate, typical of lithographic techniques. The color palette is subtle, with earth tones, greens, blues, and grays dominating the scene.

artworks.title: Yellow Sulphur Springs
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated, panoramic view of Yellow Sulphur Springs in Montgomery County, Virginia. The scene includes rolling hills, clouds, paths, a horse-drawn carriage, an oval-shaped water feature, people, trees, buildings, and fences. The color palette is soft and pastel, creating a serene atmosphere. The brushstrokes are precise and delicate, capturing architectural details and foliage textures.

artworks.title: Rockfish Gap and the Mountain House
artworks.description: The image is a panoramic view of a rural landscape. The viewpoint is elevated, showcasing a wide expanse of land extending into the distance. The horizon is lined with gently undulating hills merging into misty hues. In the foreground, a winding road with a white fence leads the eye further back. A large house is situated to the left, surrounded by trees, and smaller structures can be seen in the distant valleys. The hills and valleys are depicted with smooth brushstrokes, creating a serene atmosphere. The color palette features muted sepia tones, from light tans and beiges in the sky to darker browns and greens in the vegetation.

artworks.title: The High Bridge Near Farmville
artworks.description: The image depicts a panoramic view of a rural landscape from an elevated vantage point. A bridge with a steam engine and train cars crosses from left to right. The horizon line is near the top, partially obscured by rising terrain. The painting has a serene quality with soft brushstrokes and a color palette of muted earth tones and a washed-out blue sky. Hills with trees and a farmhouse in the foreground transition to open land with distant trees and fields beyond the bridge.

artworks.title: Stribling Springs
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated viewpoint overlooking the landscape of Stribling Springs. The horizon is positioned near the upper third of the image, with a dense cluster of trees fading into the distance. A winding dirt road leads into the scene, with a horse-drawn carriage moving towards a large white building surrounded by trees. Smaller buildings are scattered throughout the landscape. The color palette is primarily earthy browns and greens with subtle white highlights.

artworks.title: Warm Springs
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral landscape with softly undulating hills meeting the sky on the horizon. The hills are textured with a mix of green and brown tones, and a small town is nestled in a valley. The town's buildings are predominantly white and gray. Trees, patches of cultivated land, and fields surround the town, extending beyond into the valley and up the hills. The color palette is muted, dominated by earthy tones of green and brown, with subtle hints of warm yellow.

artworks.title: View from Little Sewell Mountain, No. 1
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape from an elevated viewpoint on Little Sewell Mountain in Fayette County, Virginia. The foreground features tree stumps, short trees, fields, and a white structure surrounded by trees. Rolling hills extend into the distance, blending into lighter hues towards the horizon. The sky is depicted with gentle blue-grey tones and light clouds. The color palette consists of earthy tones like ochre, deep greens, and muted blues. Brushstrokes provide detail to the foliage and terrain, while the sky is portrayed with smoother gradations.

artworks.title: View from Little Sewell Mountain, No. 2
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated view of a vast landscape. The horizon is low in the image, allowing a wide view of rolling hills extending into the distance. Hills and small mountains are visible in the horizon, creating a layered effect. The brushstrokes are detailed, capturing the textures of trees, hills, and structures. The color palette consists of muted earth tones, with shades of brown and green dominating the scene. In the foreground, there are fenced fields, scattered trees, and small buildings clustered together. A winding road or river meanders through the landscape towards the distant hills. The sky is clear with a few subtle clouds.

artworks.title: Roanoke Red Sulphur Spring
artworks.description: The image is a lithograph depicting a scenic view of Roanoke Red Sulphur Springs in Virginia. The perspective shows an elevated viewpoint of a wide expanse of land with hills or mountains in the distance. Various trees, people, and buildings are scattered throughout the landscape, creating a park-like setting. The lithographic work is detailed, with fine lines and shading capturing the texture of trees and buildings. The color palette consists of muted earthy tones like browns, greys, and greens. A path winds through the landscape, with small figures and carriages present.

artworks.title: James River Canal, Near the Mouth of the North River
artworks.description: The image shows a panoramic view of the James River Canal near the mouth of the North River. The perspective is elevated, offering a clear view of the landscape. The horizon is in the upper third, featuring mountains in the distance under a pale blue sky with wispy clouds. The canal curves gently and is lined with trees, small buildings, and horses with carts. The river winds through the scene, bordered by dense clusters of trees reaching towards the mountains. The color scheme is soft, with muted greens and browns, creating a serene visual impact. The brushstrokes are smooth and detailed, typical of an illustrative style, enhancing clarity and depth in the natural scenery.
